selection: Eight locked, never-matrix-exposed, scoreability-admitted public identities. H63 remains failure accounting. Each shared trajectory pauses at its earliest receipt-confirmed effect or falls back to the first terminal, response-pressure, output-pressure, or context-pressure boundary.
instrument_treatment: Validator-proven indeterminate calls debit their full admitted bound; affected pairs are symmetric zeros and later independent tasks continue.
treatment: At the universal decision boundary both arms receive the same neutral review. Treatment alone receives one phase-tagged decision-state/v1 projection capped at eight evidence items, 4,096 bytes, and 1,024 measured tokens.

branch_order.method: alternating control-first and guidance-first by locked task order

stopping_rules: Every scheduled identity remains in the fixed denominator.
A validator-proven zero-byte indeterminate call is debited at its full admitted bound and its pair is retained as symmetric zeros.
Stop as soon as six eligible pairs are mathematically unreachable.
Any unbounded usage, decision-boundary, held-effect, ancestry, first-prompt, exposure, or token-bound violation pauses before the next task.
claim_ceiling: Fresh GLM-5.3-flash 8K development canary only; not benchmark clearance
